node.textContent: View the task that generated this bug report

The commit at T=383.2s took 67ms (3.3ms of its 33.7ms productive render time + 33.7ms wasted), rendered 27 fibers of which 25 were wasted (no DOM mutations), and blocked the main thread for 4+ frames — an estimated 4 dropped frames, a brief visible stutter. Two cascades account for all the waste: `Projects` (direct store-rerender) propagated to 19 descendant fibers at 100% waste (22.8ms), and `SidebarProjectList` (direct store-rerender) propagated to 6 fibers at 100% waste (10.9ms). The worst single offender is react-router's `Link`: 4 wasted renders totaling 19.0ms, all caused by parent-propagation.

A background RTK-Query cache update on the Projects page should be cheap: only components whose rendered output actually changed should re-render, keeping the commit well within the 16.7ms frame budget so the page stays at 60fps with no dropped frames. Unchanged UI (sidebar nav links, project-card links, icons) should be skipped via memoization, producing no DOM mutations and no visible stutter.

React-router `Link` components in the `Projects` page and `SidebarProjectList` trees are not memoized (react-router/chunk-6CSD65Y2.mjs:10429), so when RTK-Query dispatches `projectDataApi/internalSubscriptions/subscriptionsUpdated` and two `projectDataApi/executeQuery/pending` actions, both `Projects` and `SidebarProjectList` re-render from the store and force every `Link` (and lucide-react `Icon`) descendant to re-render via parent-propagation even though their props and DOM output are unchanged. ReactPerformanceInsights commit heavy-commit-400 measures this precisely: 25 of 27 fibers rendered without producing DOM mutations (wastePercent 50.0, wastedDurationMs 33.66 of 67.32ms total); `Link` alone accounts for 4 wasted renders / 19.03ms, the lucide-react Icon for 8 wasted renders / 8.90ms, all with renderCause `parent-propagation` and wasteRate 1.0. The wasted work pushes the commit past four frame budgets, dropping frames.

node.textContent: The Replay QA Projects page is fully rendered — sidebar project list with two 'example.com' entries, filter input, and two project cards in the main grid, no loading states visible. This is the last captured frame (380844ms) before the 67ms heavy commit fired at commitTime 383224.33ms: RTK-Query subscription/query-pending updates re-rendered `Projects` and `SidebarProjectList`, cascading through un-memoized react-router `Link` components and dropping 4 frames (ReactPerformanceInsights finding heavy-commit-400) — a brief visual stutter on this otherwise idle, fully-loaded page.

attributes.title: Screenshot

node.textContent: 1. RTK-Query dispatches `projectDataApi/internalSubscriptions/subscriptionsUpdated` plus two `projectDataApi/executeQuery/pending` actions while the Projects page is open. 2. Both `Projects` (18.87ms, direct-store-rerender) and `SidebarProjectList` (14.79ms, direct-store-rerender) re-render from the store even though the project data they display is unchanged. 3. Because the react-router `Link` components in those trees (`LinkWithRef` at react-router/chunk-6CSD65Y2.mjs:10429, not wrapped in React.memo) re-render via parent-propagation, the cascade runs through 19 fibers (Projects cascade, 22.77ms, 100% waste) and 6 fibers (SidebarProjectList cascade, 10.89ms, 100% waste) with zero DOM mutations. 4. The combined 67ms commit (totalDurationMs 67.32, wastedDurationMs 33.66, 25 of 27 fibers wasted) exceeds the 16.7ms frame budget by ~4 frames, dropping 4 frames — the user sees a brief visual stutter on an otherwise fully-loaded Projects page.
